categories.main_business_segments: Camden Property Trust operates primarily in the ownership, management, development, reposition, redevelopment, acquisition, and construction of multifamily apartment communities. The company focuses exclusively on multifamily residential real estate, with all properties and activities aggregated into a single reportable segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages sophisticated property management systems, including web-based property and revenue management platforms, to optimize operations and rental pricing. Camden employs professional on-site staff and utilizes standardized processes for property maintenance, leasing, and resident services, as well as established construction and development methodologies for new and redeveloped communities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Camden's primary customers are individuals and families seeking rental housing, with a focus on urban and suburban apartment dwellers. The company serves the multifamily residential rental market, targeting regions with strong economic growth, job creation, and high demand for quality rental housing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Camden operates across major metropolitan areas in the United States, with significant property concentrations in Texas (Houston, Dallas, Austin), Florida (Orlando, Tampa, Southeast Florida), California (Los Angeles/Orange County, San Diego/Inland Empire), Washington D.C. Metro, Atlanta, Phoenix, Denver, Charlotte, Raleigh, and Nashville. As of December 31, 2022, the company owned or was developing 178 properties in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Camden operates at the downstream end of the real estate supply chain, directly providing rental housing to end consumers. The company also engages in upstream activities through property development, construction, and acquisition, but its primary value delivery is as a landlord and property manager.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Camden emphasizes consistent earnings growth through property operations, selective development and acquisitions, and capital recycling. The company focuses on market balance, geographic diversification, and operational excellence, with ongoing investments in technology, customer service, and employee training. Camden also pursues redevelopment and repositioning of existing assets to enhance value and maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Camden generates revenue primarily through rental income from multifamily apartment leases, with additional income from fees for services such as utilities, parking, and other resident amenities. The company also earns ancillary income from property management, construction, and development services, though these are less significant following recent acquisitions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Camden competes with other multifamily REITs, apartment owners, and providers of alternative housing such as condominiums, single-family rentals, and short-term rental operators. The company is positioned as a leading, large-scale, geographically diversified multifamily REIT with a reputation for operational excellence and resident satisfaction.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Camden owned interests in 178 properties with 60,652 apartment homes and reported total assets of $9.3 billion. For 2022, net income attributable to common shareholders was $653.6 million, with funds from operations (FFO) of $719.6 million and adjusted FFO of $628.9 million. The company demonstrated strong growth, with a 27.3% increase in property net operating income and an 11.2% increase in same-store revenues year-over-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Camden differentiates itself through high-quality, well-managed apartment communities in desirable, high-growth markets, supported by a strong organizational culture and commitment to resident satisfaction. The company emphasizes operational excellence, innovative property management, and a resident-focused approach, aiming to deliver superior living experiences and consistent financial performance.
